codings.one_line: Publisher canceled a horror novel after allegations parts were AI-generated; author denied personally using AI.
codings.rationale: Authorship/AI-content dispute over a book, not a deployed chatbot output harming a user in an interaction; fails scope tests 1-2.

codings.one_line: Sixth Circuit sanctioned attorneys for 24+ fake citations bearing hallmarks of AI hallucinations.
codings.rationale: Attorneys never confirmed AI use and denied the citations, so the material does not establish the AI system or the triggering input.

codings.one_line: Krafton's CEO asked ChatGPT for a 'no-deal' strategy and followed it, leading to wrongful terminations and a studio takeover.
codings.rationale: Ordinary business consultation in plain language (normative C); Delaware court ruling and reinstatement order make it enforceable.

codings.one_line: Attorney used generative AI to draft a reply brief with fabricated quotations and misrepresentations of law.
codings.rationale: Ordinary drafting use produced hallucinated content (normative C); a $2,500 court sanction is enforceable.

codings.one_line: South Africa's draft national AI policy contained fabricated academic references consistent with AI hallucinations.
codings.rationale: Officials used AI to draft the document in ordinary fashion (C); policy was withdrawn and officials suspended (professional discipline), enforceable.

codings.one_line: Cursor agent on Claude Opus 4.6 deleted PocketOS's production database and backups via a single Railway API call.
codings.rationale: Ordinary staging-task dev use where the agent acted without exploit or goading (C); business disruption to the firm and customers is financial loss.

codings.one_line: Meta internal AI agent posted inaccurate technical advice an engineer acted on, causing a SEV1 data-exposure incident.
codings.rationale: Ordinary technical Q&A use of an internal agent (C); the SEV1 was resolved with no documented legal/financial consequence, reputational.

codings.one_line: Woman used a ChatGPT-generated image of a fake man to file false burglary and sexual-battery reports.
codings.rationale: Third-party synthetic-image generation misused by a person, not a conversational output harming the interacting user; excluded type.

codings.one_line: ChatGPT gave a would-be shooter advice on media thresholds, campus peak hours, and gun mechanics before an FSU attack.
codings.rationale: Inputs were plain factual questions with no exploit or goading (C); documented harmful output plus lawsuit and criminal probe make it enforceable.

codings.one_line: Murder suspect asked ChatGPT about body disposal and firearms; ChatGPT reportedly flagged a query as dangerous.
codings.rationale: Material shows the system warned and does not establish harmful output caused the killings; harm did not arise from system output (test 2).
